title: Softwood decking boards: nominal name to minimum dressed dry size

citation.standard: Voluntary Product Standard PS 20-20, American Softwood Lumber Standard (January 2020)
citation.publisher: U.S. Department of Commerce / National Institute of Standards and Technology, for the American Lumber Standard Committee
citation.where: Table 3, "Nominal and minimum-dressed sizes of boards, dimension, and timbers", page 16 — the Boards rows, Dry columns. A 5/4 deck board is a board under PS 20-20 §3.4.1 (less than nominal 2 in thick), so its finished size is read out of the Boards block and not out of a separate decking table: the standard has no separate decking table.

entries.name: 5/4x4
entries.derivation: Table 3, Boards. Thicknesses: nominal 1-1/4 in -> 25 mm (1 in) dry. Widths: nominal 4 in -> 89 mm (3-1/2 in) dry. "5/4" is how a yard writes the nominal 1-1/4 in thickness.

entries.name: 5/4x6
entries.derivation: Table 3, Boards. Thicknesses: nominal 1-1/4 in -> 25 mm (1 in) dry. Widths: nominal 6 in -> 140 mm (5-1/2 in) dry.
